Elena (CFO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands finance Q&A. Capturing the short answers + next steps here.
Diego (Eng): thanks  what is the runway number we should use for planning?
Elena (CFO): Base-case runway = ~16 months with current signed ARR. Stress-case ~10 months if growth slows materially.
Marta (Hiring): do we pause offers in flight?
Elena (CFO): Not a full freeze. Only roles approved as 'mission-critical' by the hiring committee proceed; others paused pending weekly review.
Diego (Eng): procurement thresholds for infra purchases?
Asha (FinanceOps): effective immediately: < $25k = budget owner sign-off; $25k-$150k = owner + finance manager; > $150k = owner + finance director + CFO review + 1-page ROI for prepaids.
Diego (Eng): multi-year reserved GPUs (3yr)  approval path?
Elena (CFO): Those count as > $150k. Require ROI + utilization fallback; tag as 'customer-critical' if urgent and we'll triage in 48h.
Sam (CEO): We'll still fund high-ROI product bets aligned to OKRs but with tighter milestones (6-8 weeks).
CostBot: automated: "Infra optimization target: 12% run-rate reduction in 90 days via batching, spot instances, and quantization pilots."
Asha (FinanceOps): Practical: use the procurement form (https://redwood.internal/procure) and include vendor, term, estimated ARR impact, and GL code. Incomplete requests returned.
Diego (Eng): who is the finance contact for GPU budgeting?
Asha (FinanceOps): that's me  I'll host weekly infra budget office hours and share calendar invites.
Elena (CFO): Action items: FAQ in #finance by EOD tomorrow; updated approval matrix; hiring prioritization rubric. DM for sensitive requests.
Diego (Eng): thanks  helpful.
Marta (Hiring): thanks  we'll pause non-critical offers and notify candidates.
Elena (CFO): closing recap: runway ~16 months base; approval thresholds updated; procurement form required; hiring prioritized.
